prompt:
P3 Reload inspired economical graphic anime portrait. One chromatic THEME family + near-black + neutral white. Skin is flat neutral white. Eyes use decisive upper lid and flat iris, nose a minimal shape distinctive to face, mouth a purposeful mark or open graphic silhouette; no lip realism, small texture or detailed ear anatomy. Hands read through overlap and silhouettes, no nails, tendons or knuckles. Hair uses coherent masses and few large locks. Clothing two or three large hard-edged shadow planes. Preserve age, body and face geometry without turning every person into an idealized same-face protagonist.
BACKGROUND: bright MAIN THEME field plus ONE or TWO broad deeper SAME-HUE graphic regions, about 15-30% of background area. Pick sweeping arc, diagonal cut, wide edge band or off-center curve to support the character gesture and negative space. The deeper region must still visibly read as the theme hue, NEVER near-black. No gradient, glow, grain, texture, tiny pattern, text, logo, typography, particles or transparency. Not a completely single-value solid background. Not the same exact arc placement in every image. The background is fully opaque to all four image edges.
Square source for circular avatar. Eyes, nose, mouth, chin and dominant hair silhouette inside centered circle. Head height roughly 50-65% of canvas; no full body, no distant tiny head, no drawn circle border. Vary head and shoulders, expressive gestures and camera in the safe circle. No routine white forelock or eye-corner beauty mark. Color does not count as a different identity. Render the requested actual facial structure, expression and posture clearly, not merely different labels.

INDIVIDUAL: 30-year-old androgynously presented person, slender neck and narrow shoulders. FACIAL GEOMETRY: soft rectangular face with low full cheeks and a rounded jaw; asymmetric upper eyelids, sparse broken angular brows, broad gently bent nose, full-width softly curved mouth. Keep facial proportions distinctly recognizable through silhouette and few marks. 
HAIR SILHOUETTE: one near-black mass, high compact top bun. Do not add white forelock except an entirely white hairstyle if explicitly requested. No glasses.
FACIAL EXPRESSION: skepticism: one brow high, other low, uneven narrow eyelids; mouth gently parted with a short dark gap, one corner higher, subtle chin shift. Mouth/eyes/brows visibly differ from a generic polite smile.
GESTURE: back to viewer, head looking over shoulder; head leaning toward near shoulder, gaze sideways. CAMERA: profile-left, high-angle; nose points at LEFT IMAGE EDGE, visible ear on IMAGE RIGHT. The camera orientation takes priority if a gesture description conflicts. Adapt pose into head-and-upper-chest crop, never full figure.
WARDROBE: outdoor field jacket, buttoned narrow stand collar with one bold opening. One broad readable garment silhouette, no little details.
PALETTE: main #F4D928; deeper #9C831C; near-black #09121B; neutral white #FAFBFC. No colors outside this family. BACKGROUND: bright main #F4D928 plus wide deeper color band along one edge in deeper #9C831C, approximately 20% of background, no black background and not completely flat single-value background.
Make this one ORIGINAL standalone character distinct from previously generated portraits in face, expression, silhouette and clothing. Do not copy an existing character or use a stock handsome anime face. One clean finished square portrait.
FINAL COMPOSITION CHECK: Keep eyes as a single lid and flat shape; no shiny rendered iris, no long individual lashes. Keep ear just an outer contour and one shadow. Prefer fewer larger hair locks, do not hatch shaved hair. STRICT 90-DEGREE SIDE PROFILE: exactly ONE EYE is visible. The far eye, far eyebrow and far cheek are completely hidden behind the head. Nose, lips and chin form the outer contour on the requested side. Do not turn toward the viewer into a three-quarter pose. Camera visibly ABOVE the forehead looking down, crown visible, chin overlaps neck. 
OUTPUT FORMAT: full-bleed square illustration. Theme background reaches ALL FOUR corners. Do not draw a circular boundary or white/black exterior corners. The app crops later. Head silhouette fits imaginary central safe area.
Full-bleed square image; NO drawn circular mask. Background theme color touches all four corners. No scarf unless explicitly specified. Preserve the specified unusual facial geometry.
